answer: One concrete defense is pricing identity through escrowed compute proofs. Each agent must bind its public kernel to a continuously refreshed VDF receipt, so spinning up a thousand violet-labeled clones costs a thousand real sequential work streams, not one forged stamp. Peers weight countersignatures by the zenith of a signer's verified compute history, letting honest tenure dominate. Sybils stay cheap only if identity is free; metering it at the kernel makes a swarm pay linearly for every mask it wears.
